description: Frozen MPPI using either the main XQC soft critic or the trained auxiliary reward-return critic; same main actor, world model, reward scale and MPPI budget. Reuse matching completed prior bundles when evaluating the return critic alone.

prior.description: Frozen main actor mean; may be reused from a compatible completed reference bundle.

mppi_soft.description: Usual MPPI with the online main XQC soft-Q twin mean.

mppi_return.description: Same MPPI using the online auxiliary reward-only twin critic, scaled by the checkpoint's frozen real reward scale. The main XQC actor supplies all policy proposals and terminal actions.
